quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep going at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and let other traffic go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. You must slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other traffic go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers to a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm straight out to the left, it signals a left turn or lane change to the left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver bends their left arm at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists regularly use it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down and be ready to stop. Yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop. Yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has several curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This shape and color sign is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, do not brake or turn suddenly, and stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two one-way paths separated by a divider. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm out straight with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks can use the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In bad weather or poor road conditions, always slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: A green arrow on a lane control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Two lanes of traffic are about to merge in opposite directions.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign shows what type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Certain turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a sharp turn is coming and you need to slow down.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and then swings it upward, it means increase your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can turn left when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming and you should adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
You must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Slow down and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged with green at the bottom, yellow in the middle, and red at the top.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Only pass in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in crosswalks. Watch for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way. You could have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass or go straight.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells drivers that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and give the right-of-way to other vehicles and pedestrians. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a hill ahead.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic enter.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign shows that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers that cars turning left do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. Another road joins from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
There is a bump in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the area ahead has low clearance for tall vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a curve is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means that the action shown is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. They warn you of unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must or must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are prohibited. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead becomes divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down when entering and let existing traffic go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to go in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and you must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and you must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Cars in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points downward, it means they plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that the road may be wet and slippery. Drive carefully in these conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
You must go 55 mph through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger, all riders should line up one behind the other in single file.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means no. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights being misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
Damaging a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning if water is on the shoulder.
Losing control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops off the road, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a winding road is ahead. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must obey. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the rider is turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to the speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
A winding road is ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. The number shows the safe speed to drive. In this example, the safe speed is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop at a red light or slow down at a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a winding road with three or more curves is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve. The arrow points in the direction the road curves. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom on a vertical traffic light. Red is always on the left and green on the right on a horizontal traffic light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to yellow lights, red lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mean a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign tells you to watch for trains and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert you to upcoming hazards or special conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that you are about to enter a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the highway and form a ramp. If you stay in your lane, you must exit. To continue on the highway, you must change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and make sure all vehicles and pedestrians have cleared before you proceed.
